name: Fact card
description: One number that makes the point: the figure in the brand colour, what it says, some context and its source line, on the brand's paper. The figure is a claim that needs a source.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short label in the dark pill, e.g. WHY IT MATTERS. Leave empty for none.

fact_value.label: Figure
fact_value.description: The number, e.g. 80% or 3.2M. A claim: bind it to its source.

fact_statement.label: What it says
fact_statement.description: The fact in one sentence, read with the figure.

context.label: Context
context.description: A sentence or two on why it matters. Leave empty for none.

source_label.label: Source line
source_label.description: Where the number comes from, shown on the card, e.g. Source: Gartner, 2026.

counter.label: Page counter
counter.description: For a post in a series, e.g. 02 / 10. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The account handle shown top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: The footer's call to action, e.g. Save this post. Leave empty for none.

sample_data.fact_statement: of its agent's tools Vercel removed, and the agent got faster and better.
sample_data.context: Fewer tools meant fewer wrong turns: the model spent its effort on the task, not on choosing.
